findings.title: Potential IDOR via filteredFiles
findings.detail: The filteredFiles field is merged using a union of files per agent across chunks, which could lead to information disclosure if an agent's intended scope is not properly restricted.
findings.evidence: filteredFiles left that list for the same reason and by the same test: it was diagnostic only while nothing rendered it, and four formatters now raise a coverage warning from it.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that filteredFiles is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before merging.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that filteredFiles is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before merging.

findings.title: Potential Null Dereference
findings.detail: Accessing result.policy.agentsSkipped without checking if result.policy is null or undefined.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit null check for result.policy before accessing result.policy.agentsSkipped.
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit null check for result.policy before accessing result.policy.agentsSkipped.

findings.title: Potential IDOR via mergePolicy
findings.detail: The mergePolicy function uses an intersection to determine agentsSkipped, which could lead to information disclosure if an agent's intended scope is not properly restricted.
findings.evidence: Intersection is the only reading under which the rendered "skipped entirely -- their domains were not reviewed" is true.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that mergePolicy is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before merging.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that mergePolicy is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before merging.

findings.title: Potential IDOR via attributeChunkSkips
findings.detail: The attributeChunkSkips function attributes files to agents that were skipped in a chunk, which could lead to information disclosure if an agent's intended scope is not properly restricted.
findings.evidence: A per-chunk skip is precisely a narrowed view of the overall diff, which filteredFiles already renders truthfully, so the chunk's files are attributed there instead.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that attributeChunkSkips is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before attributing files.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that attributeChunkSkips is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before attributing files.

findings.title: Potential IDOR via agentsWithNarrowedView
findings.detail: The agentsWithNarrowedView function returns agents whose view of the diff was narrowed by agentPolicy, which could lead to information disclosure if an agent's intended scope is not properly restricted.
findings.evidence: Agents whose view of the diff was NARROWED by agentPolicy without the agent being skipped.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that agentsWithNarrowedView is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before returning agents.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that agentsWithNarrowedView is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before returning agents.

findings.title: Potential IDOR via narrowedFileCount
findings.detail: The narrowedFileCount function returns the total file sections withheld from at least one agent by an agentPolicy exclude, which could lead to information disclosure if an agent's intended scope is not properly restricted.
findings.evidence: Total file sections withheld from at least one agent by an agentPolicy exclude.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that narrowedFileCount is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before returning the count.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that narrowedFileCount is properly scoped to the current user's permissions before returning the count.

findings.title: Inefficient policy merge logic
findings.detail: The policy merge logic in chunkRunner.ts incorrectly uses the length of chunks with any skip as the denominator, leading to inaccurate skipped agent reporting.
findings.recommendation: Use the total chunk count as the denominator: results.length instead of withPolicy.length.
findings.impact: Incorrect reporting of skipped agents across chunks.

findings.title: Potential Off-by-One Error in Merge Policy Logic
findings.detail: The line withPolicy.length === 0 could lead to incorrect policy merging when all chunks have policy data but not all chunks skip agents.
findings.recommendation: Use results.length instead of withPolicy.length for the denominator to correctly identify agents skipped in all chunks.
findings.suggestion: Use results.length instead of withPolicy.length for the denominator to correctly identify agents skipped in all chunks.

findings.recommendation: Consider rethrowing or handling the error more explicitly to avoid silent failures
